candidate_ideas.statement: The exact geometric monodromy image H_alpha inside a conjugate of the imprimitive wreath product S_2 wr S_3 on a type-(ii) fibre determines the S_6-isotypic decomposition of ordinary and Borel-Moore cohomology of the ordering cover on a purely type-(ii) component.
A connected component of a balanced+(CE)+(N) base can consist entirely of type-(ii) fibres, equivalently the type-(i) hypothesis in the family monodromy statement is not automatic.
A non-primitive degree-four pencil factoring through an intermediate curve of genus two or three can satisfy (BAL); if such a cover is balanced, degree reasons force it to be of type (i).

The family, Abel-Jacobi, and ordering-torsor statements extend from reduced locally Noetherian schemes to algebraic stacks with inertia (or to a smooth atlas with descent of AJ=P(pi_*L)) and to nonreduced bases, after a separate lifting argument for Grauert local freeness and constant-rank cohomology.
The H_alpha-object given by ordinary or Borel-Moore cohomology of a connected component of the ordering cover is mixed-Tate as a mixed Hodge structure.

There is a stack-level identification of Aut groups for the Abel-Jacobi incidence with Aut(C,gamma,Gamma), and a morphism from the balanced ordered model to M_{6,6} that is representable, unramified, quasi-finite, and whose image has identifiable closure.

The balanced base of the family is irreducible, so the component correspondence for the incidence, its distinct-support open, and the ordered cover reduces to a single component of the ordered evaluation-obstruction locus.

Characteristic-zero reflexivity/biduality for a reduced irreducible plane curve (birationality of the Gauss map onto the dual curve) and Jordan's theorem that a primitive subgroup of S_n containing a transposition is S_n hold as inputs to the type-(i) monodromy argument.

established_facts.evidence: proof/packets/generated/C66-001-v4.md, Primary locator excerpt SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (degree/Serre-duality calculation).
established_facts.statement: For the Casnati-Ekedahl summands W_{f_i}=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-f_i))|_C one has deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=2(2g-2+4*2)-4f_i=4g+12-4f_i. The obstruction space splits as a direct sum over i, and the summand for f_i vanishes whenever 0>4f_i+n-2g-14.

established_facts.evidence: proof/packets/generated/C66-001-v4.md, Canonical geometric bottleneck, CE line-bundle convention and Degree calculation bullets.
established_facts.statement: The CE line-bundle convention is W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C, the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C; it is not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F. For g=6 one has deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1})=6.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C->P^1 with balanced splitting F=O(4) oplus O(5), the f=4 CE obstruction bundle omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma) has degree -4 for every degree-six divisor Gamma, hence H^0 vanishes identically on that summand; the f=5 component has degree 0, and evaluation is obstructed on Gamma if and only if O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: proof/packets/generated/C66-001-v4.md, FND-0105 together with SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6.
established_facts.statement: Granting the weak relative-canonical normalization O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C isomorphic to omega_{C/P^1} tensor gamma^*A for some A in Pic(P^1), the degree comparison deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C)=2g+6=deg(omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2)) forces deg A=0 and A isomorphic to O_{P^1}. Hence W_5 is isomorphic to omega_C^2(-D), L is isomorphic to omega_C(-D), and M:=omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee is isomorphic to O_C(D).
If C is hyperelliptic of genus 6 and gamma has degree 4, then gamma=q o h necessarily, E=O(1) oplus O(4) oplus O(4), and the relations bundle is exactly F=O(2) oplus O(7).

Under the fibrewise-balanced hypothesis F_b isomorphic to O(4) oplus O(5), the jump stratum B_4={h^0(L)=4} is empty, so h^0(L) is identically 3. On every such geometric fibre one has h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2. Constancy uses exclusion of the hyperelliptic-composed pencil and is not equivalent to exclusion of every non-primitive degree-four pencil through a positive-genus intermediate curve.

The functor of relative effective divisors Gamma with O(Gamma) isomorphic to L is represented by the Abel-Jacobi fibre Sym^d(C/B) x_{Pic^d_{C/B}} B, which is closed because the relative Picard is separated; on a smooth curve Hilb^d=Sym^d. This model is correct over all of B, whereas Proj(pi_*L) has correct fibres only over the open where h^0(L) is constant.

The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus. With Q-coefficients, S_6-invariants and S_6-coinvariants agree.

Let U be a connected quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme over a field and Z->U a finite etale right S_6-torsor. Connected components of Z are indexed by the orbit set H\S_6 of left multiplication (the right cosets Hg), the right deck action is transitive, and the stabilizer of Hg is g^{-1}Hg. If U is normal, integral and locally Noetherian, those components are the irreducible components, each of degree |H| over U. Connectedness of the torsor is equivalent to H=S_6, not to transitivity of H on six letters.

Over a normal finite-type scheme base in characteristic zero, for the finite etale right S_6-torsor Z_alpha->U_alpha with monodromy image H_alpha, any additive S_6-equivariant functor F to Q-vector spaces or mixed Hodge structures satisfies F(Z_alpha) isomorphic to Ind_{H_alpha}^{S_6} F(Z_alpha^1) and F(Z_alpha)^{S_6} isomorphic to F(U_alpha). The isomorphism is formal and does not force Tate type.

Assume (CE)+(N)+(BAL) on a smooth connected genus-6 geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, with D=gamma^*O_{P^1}(1) and L=omega_C(-D) of degree 6 and h^0(L)=3, and with L base-point-free. Then phi_L:C->P^2 is finite onto an integral nondegenerate plane curve X_L with deg(phi_L)*deg(X_L)=6, and exactly one of two exclusive cases occurs: type (i), deg phi_L=1 and X_L is an integral plane sextic of geometric genus six with normalization C; or type (ii), deg phi_L=2, X_L is a smooth plane cubic Y, psi=phi_L is a bielliptic double cover, gamma=q o psi with q of degree two, and E isomorphic to O(2) oplus O(3) oplus O(4).

Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic 0, Y a smooth genus-one curve, P in Pic^2(Y), q=phi_{|P|}:Y->P^1, M in Pic^5(Y), B a reduced divisor in |M^{tensor 2}|, and psi:C->Y the double cover with psi_*O_C isomorphic to O_Y oplus M^{-1}. Then C is smooth and connected of genus six, gamma=q o psi is finite flat Gorenstein of degree four, and the Casnati-Ekedahl bundles split as E isomorphic to O(2) oplus O(3) oplus O(4) and F isomorphic to O(4) oplus O(5). Thus a non-primitive tetragonal pencil factoring through a genus-one curve can lie in the balanced F-locus. The statement addresses intermediate genus one only.

On a balanced type-(i) geometric fibre satisfying (CE)+(N)+(BAL) at (g,n)=(6,6) over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, the geometric monodromy image of pi_1^{et}(|L|^{rs})->S_6 is the full symmetric group S_6, so the finite etale S_6-torsor Ord(|L|^{rs}) is connected. Over any connected component of a reduced locally Noetherian balanced+(CE)+(N) base that contains at least one type-(i) geometric fibre, H_alpha=S_6. In type (ii) the monodromy image lies in a conjugate of the imprimitive wreath product S_2 wr S_3 of order 48 and is not S_6.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001, mechanically verified for all cases; arithmetic d=3*6-3+6=21 and 2d-16=26.
established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d). At (g,n)=(6,6) one has d=21, so the exact group is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21).

established_facts.evidence: Substitution into deg(omega_C tensor W_f^vee(Gamma))=4f+n-2g-14 at g=n=6 yields -4 for f=4 and 0 for f=5; line-bundle algebra on a smooth connected projective curve.
established_facts.statement: On a smooth projective geometrically connected curve, a line bundle of negative degree has no nonzero global section, and a degree-zero line bundle has a nonzero global section if and only if it is trivial. Hence at (g,n)=(6,6) one has H^0(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=0 for every effective degree-six Gamma, while H^0(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) is nonzero if and only if O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: Riemann-Roch chi(L)=6-6+1=1; Serre duality h^1(L)=h^0(M); Clifford bound deg(M)/2+1=3; recorded independently as packet FND-0073 and FND-0103.
established_facts.statement: On every smooth genus-6 geometric fibre of the balanced tetragonal CE family, chi(L)=1 and h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) where M:=omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee has deg M=4. Moreover M is always special, Clifford gives h^0(M)<=3, so h^0(L) lies in {1,2,3,4} and never equals 5; the value h^0(L)=4 occurs only on hyperelliptic fibres.

Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced+(N) genus-6 family, the evaluation-obstruction scheme Z inside Conf_6(C/S) is S-smooth of pure relative dimension two via identification with the S_6-torsor of orderings of the reduced-support open of P_S(pi_*L), and the closed immersion Z->Conf_6 is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free conormal of rank four.

That S_6 has rational irreducible representations does not imply that an S_6-cover of a relative configuration or linear-system space carries only Tate local systems; geometric monodromy of the tetragonal family and configuration-space coefficients can still produce non-Tate summands.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Transitivity of G on six letters already holds for A_6. For a right S_6-torsor the connected components are indexed by the orbit set H\S_6 of left multiplication, so connectedness is equivalent to H=S_6 (a single right coset), not to transitivity. Since [S_6:A_6]=2, an A_6 image would give two connected components.
invalid_steps.statement: Connectedness of the finite etale right S_6-torsor Ord(|L|^{rs})->|L|^{rs} is equivalent to transitivity of the monodromy image G on the six points of a general divisor.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The orbits of left multiplication of H on G are the right cosets Hg; the set of those orbits is H\G. Genuine left cosets are gH, and right multiplication on G/H={gH} is well-defined if and only if H is normal in G. The stabilizer of the component indexed by Hg is g^{-1}Hg, not gHg^{-1}, unless H is normal.
invalid_steps.statement: The set of orbits of left multiplication by a monodromy image H on S_6 may be named left cosets H\S_6, and the right deck action may then be written on symbols gH with component stabilizer gHg^{-1}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Where h^0(L) jumps, pi_*L does not commute with base change and Proj(pi_*L) has the wrong fibres; the construction is valid only over the open locus of constant h^0. The base-independent model is the Abel-Jacobi incidence Sym^6(C/B) x_{Pic^6(C/B)} B, closed by separatedness of the relative Picard scheme, and it agrees with Proj(pi_*L) only over that open.
invalid_steps.statement: The relative degree-six linear system may be identified with Proj(pi_*L) over an arbitrary base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Fibrewise balancedness only supplies the relative Harder-Narasimhan filtration 0->W_4->W->W_5->0. A global splitting is an extra hypothesis: its obstruction is the extension class in Ext^1_{P^1_B}(L_4,L_5), which lies in H^1(B, gamma'_*O(1)) and need not vanish over a general base, while the fibrewise Ext vanishes so no local obstruction is visible.
invalid_steps.statement: Fibrewise balancedness F_s isomorphic to O(4) oplus O(5) yields a global direct-sum splitting W isomorphic to W_4 oplus W_5 over the base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finiteness of Gamma gives only exactness of restriction to Gamma and exactness of pushforward along Gamma->B. Surjectivity of pi_*W->pi_*W_5 along the curve fibration is the separate vanishing R^1 pi_* W_4=0, which must be certified by deg W_4>2g-2 and rechecked whenever deg W_4<=2g-2.
invalid_steps.statement: Exactness of pi_* on the filtration 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 follows from finiteness of Gamma over the base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Grauert's criterion requires the base to be reduced. Over a nonreduced base, constant dimensions of the cohomology of a perfect two-term complex on geometric fibres do not imply locally free cohomology; a separate scheme-theoretic constant-rank or lifting argument is required.
invalid_steps.statement: Constancy of cohomology dimensions on geometric fibres implies that pi_*L and R^1 pi_*L are locally free and commute with arbitrary base change over a possibly nonreduced base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The balanced reduced-support model is only an open piece of the evaluation-obstruction locus; Gysin for (M_{6,6},Z) requires a closed stratified embedding obtained after h^0 and splitting-type stratification. Openness of balancedness inside the tetragonal locus supplies neither closedness nor purity.
invalid_steps.statement: The balanced reduced-support relative linear system is a closed pure-codimension-four subvariety of M_{6,6}, so a Gysin morphism applies to the pair (M_{6,6},Z).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: M_{6,6} forgets the pencil gamma, and a general genus-6 curve carries five distinct g^1_4's, so the underlying forgetful map is generically five-to-one; injectivity requires recovering gamma from L, whose only standard route is L isomorphic to omega_C(-D), returning the pencil as |omega_C tensor L^{-1}|. Additionally, CE obstruction is a condition on the pair (C,gamma), not on a point of M_{6,6}.
invalid_steps.statement: The balanced CE obstruction model maps monomorphically into an evaluation-obstruction locus in M_{6,6} even if one disclaims the identification L isomorphic to omega_C(-D).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The canonical torsor is I->I^{red-supp} and its reduced form is I_red->(I^{red-supp})_red; reducing only the source generally destroys flatness over nonreduced bases, so the finite etale torsor property is lost.
invalid_steps.statement: The ordered-to-unordered reduced-support construction may be formed by reducing only the source, i.e. I_red->I^{red-supp}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A connected finite etale cover of a connected locally Noetherian base need not be irreducible; connectedness and irreducibility diverge on non-normal bases, so the [S_6:H] component formula requires normality or an independent geometric-irreducibility argument.
invalid_steps.statement: The count of pi_1^{et}-orbits of a finite etale S_6-cover upgrades to a count of irreducible components without a normality hypothesis on the base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: That argument computes Aut(C,gamma,Gamma), automorphisms of the tetragonal cover preserving the divisor, whereas the group relevant to M_{6,6} is Aut(C,Gamma). An automorphism of C preserving Gamma need not preserve the pencil, and a nontrivial automorphism of a genus-6 curve can fix as many as 2g+2=14 points and hence can fix six marked points.
invalid_steps.statement: A stabilizer or inertia clause for the forgetful map to M_{6,6} follows from observing that an automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation of P^1 fixing the marked images.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Expected-codimension bookkeeping is neither necessary nor sufficient for regularity: a component of codimension below the determinantal expectation may still be locally cut out by a regular sequence of its actual codimension. The valid route is a closed immersion between schemes smooth over the base, whose codimension is the relative-dimension difference.
invalid_steps.statement: Local complete intersection or regular-immersion of a degeneracy locus follows from comparing its actual codimension with the generic determinantal expected codimension.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Rational irreducibility of the representations of the deck group does not constrain the geometric monodromy of the tetragonal family or the configuration-space coefficients, and a finite pushforward of the constant sheaf may contain non-Tate local systems; rational averaging preserves an already established Tate structure but cannot create one.
invalid_steps.statement: Rationality of the irreducible representations of S_6, or a finite branch morphism of the Hurwitz stack to an open of a moduli of pointed rational curves, implies pure-Tate cohomology of the obstruction locus.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: h^0(L)=4 forces h^0(M)=3=deg(M)/2+1, i.e. Clifford equality on a special degree-four bundle with deg M not in {0,2g-2}, hence hyperellipticity and gamma=q o h; that composed cover has E=O(1)+O(4)^2 and h^0(F(-6))>=2, incompatible with F=O(4)+O(5). The stratum is empty, so no P^3 piece exists.
invalid_steps.statement: A nonempty jump piece B_4 with fibre P^3 occurs in a balanced component decomposition.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Distinct parameter points can represent isomorphic objects or repeated members and therefore can have the same image; object-level uniqueness does not imply space-level injectivity.
invalid_steps.statement: Object-level uniqueness of a geometric fibre implies injectivity of the corresponding morphism of parameter spaces.

reusable_computations.statement: Under the balanced hypothesis with the weak relative-canonical normalization: h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^1(L)=h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1})=h^0(O_C(D))=2, and h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)=3 on every geometric fibre.
deg W_5=4g+12-4f at (g,f)=(6,5) equals 16; deg L=deg W_5-(2g-2)=6; chi(L)=6-6+1=1; deg M=2(2g-2)-16=4; h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) by Serre duality.
For g=6 and n=6, d=3g-3+n=21 and 2d-16=26.
For a degree-six divisor Gamma, 4f+n-2g-14 equals -4 for f=4 and 0 for f=5.
For L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, deg(L)=6 and chi(L)=deg(L)-g+1=1.
Poincare duality reindexing at (g,n)=(6,6): d=3*6-3+6=21, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} corresponds to W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(d)=W_{26}H^{26}(21), with 2d-16=26.
Internal-consistency check of the degree formula: deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C)=2g-2+4*2=18 at g=6 and gamma of degree 4, so 2*18-4f=36-4f=4g+12-4f, reproducing 16 at f=5 and 20 at f=4.
b=2g-2-4(-2)=18; dim(Hurwitz)=18-3=15; dim(Z)=15+2=17; numerical codimension in M_{6,6} is 21-17=4.
Expected determinantal codimension of {rk phi<=k-3} for ranks k,k-1 is 3*2=6.
chi(O_C(Gamma))=deg-g+1=6-6+1=1 for g=6 and deg Gamma=6.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: The exact monodromy image inside the wreath product S_2 wr S_3 on a type-(ii) fibre, and therefore the S_6-isotypic decomposition of cohomology of the ordering cover on a purely type-(ii) component.
Whether a connected component of a balanced+(CE)+(N) base can consist entirely of type-(ii) fibres, equivalently whether the type-(i) hypothesis in the family monodromy statement is automatic.
Whether a non-primitive degree-four pencil factoring through an intermediate curve of genus two or three can satisfy (BAL); if such a cover is balanced, degree reasons force it to be of type (i).

Extension of the family, Abel-Jacobi, and ordering-torsor statements from reduced locally Noetherian schemes to algebraic stacks with inertia (or to a smooth atlas with descent of the identification AJ=P(pi_*L)) and to nonreduced bases, where Grauert local freeness and constant-rank cohomology need a separate lifting argument.

The H_alpha-object given by ordinary or Borel-Moore cohomology of a connected component of the ordering cover, as a mixed Hodge structure; the induction isomorphism does not determine Tate type of that object.

A stack-level identification of Aut groups for the Abel-Jacobi incidence versus Aut(C,gamma,Gamma), and the existence, representability, unramifiedness, quasi-finiteness, and image-closure properties of a morphism from the balanced ordered model to M_{6,6}.

Characteristic-zero reflexivity/biduality for a reduced irreducible plane curve (birationality of the Gauss map onto the dual curve) and Jordan's theorem that a primitive subgroup of S_n containing a transposition is S_n, if these are used as inputs rather than independently established.

Irreducibility of the balanced base of the family, and consequently the number of irreducible components of the ordered evaluation-obstruction locus, are undetermined; the component correspondence only transports components of the base to components of the incidence and its distinct-support open.

The unbalanced Casnati-Ekedahl strata are unconstructed: the evaluation-obstruction locus off the balanced splitting locus, and any closure point of the balanced locus lying outside it, are not exhibited.

Descent of any cohomological or weight computation from the ordered model to the unordered one is available only rationally (S_6-invariants equal coinvariants with Q-coefficients); integral-coefficient and coarse-space versions require independent justification.
